observedIssue.schemaMessage: Step markers must respect barrier and scenario order

rootCause: The recorder lowers its host barrier to the minimum mapped source dispatch time. A source marker within its valid host bracket and uncertainty can map just before the host scenario start. The schema then rejects the backdated barrier once for each side.
scopeLimits: This identifies the reproduced diagnostic rejection. The original full-suite validation-3 rejected document was not retained, so its exact cause remains unproven.
This is distinct from the independently reproduced 60-second duration boundary.
The comparison was instrumented only to retain the original parse rejection privately. It is not release acceptance.

priorSetupFailure.cause: Public payload archive was not readable by the non-root container user after docker cp.
priorSetupFailure.correction: The same archive bytes were copied with mode0644 inside a private directory.
